overview: Carolina, Antonia and her mother Maria escape to Milan after murdered her violent father, in the city Antonia seeks to follow her mother's dream of become a singer but shortly after they discover that the true talent lies with Carolina.
title: Belcanto

overview: A gifted pianist at a prestigious music school has his meticulous world shaken up by a free-spirited piano prodigy, who both annoys and charms him.
title: Cantabile Tomorrow

overview: As the clock ticks down, contestants need to think fast and recall facts quickly to score big. With quick-fire quizzes featuring five questions each, players dive into one of eight categories, like music, movies, TV, history, sports, and more.
title: Trivia Loop

overview: One day, a woman from the past appears in the life of Moscow lawyer Mikhail – his first love, the daughter of a gypsy baron, Diana. She asks for help in releasing their daughter Yana from prison in exchange for keeping Mikhail's secret, because he is pretending to be someone else. In fact, he is a gypsy named Mihai Demetre, who was expelled from the camp 16 years ago. Mihai returns to the camp where he grew up to save the daughter he never knew existed and to face his past.
title: Улица Шекспира

overview: Winter Gold is an intimate docuseries about the lives and driving forces behind seven winter sports athletes as they continue their quest for glory. It's the story of what it really takes to become the best.
title: Winter Gold

overview: Orla Chennaoui and Adam Blythe are joined by the stars of cycling for a comprehensive guide to bike racing on the track, road and in the mountains.
title: The Ultimate Cycling Show

overview: Arif and his daughter Ela try to escape the city in an ambulance with their neighbor Melek after an explosion in the sun creates chaos. While the journey inevitably leads to confrontations, Arif almost feels reconnected to himself after being crushed under the expectations of modern life for years.
title: Derin Mor

overview: Helene Olafsen and Marius Skjelbæk invite you to a party on the day of the World Championships together with Petter Northug and Tiril Eckhoff. Meet medal winners, guests and artists.
title: VM-showet

overview: If there were a guide for love, would Bunny not have been a pushover? Although she is crazy over good looks, Bunny believes sincerity is more important when dating. The result? Her first love with terrible looks and an awful personality turns out to be the worst, and she becomes known as a school-wide pushover. With the determination to never fail again, Bunny declares she will no longer act like a doormat and only date alpha males when four outstanding oppas appear before her. Bunny's heart gets no rest amid the endless parade of high-quality flirting, aimed to win her over and become her number one oppa. Is this a guide to stop being a pushover? Or is it a proper dating course for falling in love? Will Bunny the pushover transform into a dating genius?
title: Crushology 101

overview: Million Dollar Secret In this cutthroat competition series, an undercover millionaire must hide in plain sight and evade elimination to keep the money and win the game.
title: Million Dollar Secret

overview: Video Hits was a Canadian music video program broadcast nationally on CBC Television from 1984 to 1993. Created by producer Sandra Faire, Video Hits aired weekday afternoons, and featured promotional music videos of the day's top hit songs from Canadian and international artists, along with artist interviews. The show's original host was Samantha Taylor. A similar music video show, Good Rockin' Tonite, also aired on CBC Television on Friday nights concurrently with Video Hits.
title: Video HIts

overview: Fortune or folly? In this documentary series, real-life treasure hunters dive into a years-long search for hidden riches in the Rocky Mountains.
title: Gold & Greed: The Hunt for Fenn's Treasure

overview: Raya is forced to leave medical school and go to work for a cleaning company to pay for an expensive operation for her sick father Andrei Vetrov. One day, while cleaning a luxury apartment, Raya meets the owner of the apartment, a representative of the golden youth Pavel Olkhovsky. The young people fall in love with each other. But Pavel's mother, the owner of a business empire Inga, is categorically against her son's relationship with a simple cleaner: she dreams of marrying him to the daughter of her main competitor Evgeny Sokolov. Together with the company's lawyer Viktor Danilov, Inga comes up with a plan to get rid of the girl. Will Raya be able to save her love and find happiness?..
title: Круги на воде

overview: The programme will follow the original format with the playing teams made up of an amateur dart player, known as the ‘thrower', and their team partner, the ‘knower'. They will combine their skills, throwing darts at different game boards, whilst answering questions correctly for ‘points and prizes'. This brand new series, produced by ITV Studios, will also see professional darts players taking to the oche to help along the contestants and the return of Master of Ceremonies Richard Ashdown.
title: Bullseye

overview: A satirical black comedy TV series from Palestine and Jordan that addresses the difficult political and social challenges facing Arab communities.
title: Sukaj

overview: The project covers the whole variety of genres of Russian music, not constrained by the framework of pop music, chanson, rock pop and classical music, while enjoying enormous popular popularity. The show's episodes are dedicated to urban romance, author's song, movie hits, cinema, the work of Russian emigration and some other genres.
title: Три аккорда
Lewis & Clark: The Journey of the Corps of Discovery

overview: Private detective Maloney investigates with mischief, charm and unmistakable thuggishness.
title: Maloney

overview: Evgeniy dreams of getting on a scooter, and Anna wants to stop being afraid and jump with a parachute. Maksim is a mentor and believes that his mentee will one day perform on the big stage. Each of them literally lost a part of themselves. They have lost an arm or a leg and do not yet know how to build their lives further. But each of them meets their guide, who will help them realize their dream and take a step into the future of cyborgs.
title: Киборг

overview: A waitress from a provincial karaoke bar, Sofia, accidentally ends up in Moscow for the talent show "Fly into Trends" in order to be closer to her boyfriend, Ilya, who is already a professional singer and is participating in the same show in a duet with his ex-girlfriend Katya.
title: Залетела в тренды

overview: Psychologists distinguish six types of female killers: the avenger, the angel of death, the bloody lady, Snow White's stepmother, the black widow and the mercenary killer. Journalist Oksana Shcherbakova will visit women's prisons, show their daily life and tell about several criminal types using real convicted women as examples, including the most brutal serial killer in Russia.
title: Хрупкие убийцы

overview: After the rich and beautiful Li Zhiqing marries self-made man Wang Yan, she becomes a full-time housewife, devoting herself to the family. However, it turns out that behind their seemingly happy marriage is the betrayal of her husband and best friend, who are cheating behind her back. When her father unexpectedly falls off a building, the company runs into trouble. Wang Yan, her once good husband, even shows his true colors, greedily competing with her to take control of the company. The awakened housewife fights back with all her might, showing no mercy in torturing the scumbag and seizing power, rewriting her life with great gusto.
title: The Awakening of Housewives
There is No Place to Escape

overview: "Excellent Souls (ExSo)" is a rock band consists of Lee Min Ki, Kang Hyuk, Yoo Han Chul and Han Ki Joon. However, they were unable to debut due to certain circumstances and they continue to live as normal ordinary people. After seven years, Min Ki was caught by a loan shark. In order to pay back his debt, he decided to move to the countryside and becoming a farmer to grow cabbages. The other ExSo members also follow Min Ki to the village with the aim to realize their old dream to debut and make an album. While coming to the Hadurok Ri village, Min Ki accidentally jumped into his childhood first love, Yoonhee. This drama tells the stories of their dreams, loves and friendships.
title: Modern Farmer

overview: Next Level Baker will test the skills of bakers as they are challenged to create eye-popping, festive holiday delights across the franchise's three iconic levels. During the series' four special hours, only one baker will rise to the top and claim the holiday baking crown.
title: Next Level Baker

overview: SC+ will be built around the highly popular "SC Top 10" daily countdown of sports moments. The program will deliver the most important sports news stories of the day, complemented by insights from ESPN's top insiders and reporters. The fast-paced update will highlight each day's top sports moments, stories, insights and exclusive commentary in a more concise and streamlined format.
title: SC+

overview: A show where any aspiring artist gets a chance to become trending by recording a track with a top artist. In times when information is consumed very quickly, we will show that you can win the love of the audience in literally 30 seconds and you don't need anything other than your talent to do this.
title: Залетай в тренды

overview: Competition is fierce in the hotel business. Online review sites can kill a business' reputation with one bad review. Staffs are untrained, surly or apathetic in a profession that lives or dies on service. So what's a struggling hotel operator to do? Bring in Anthony Melchiorri, a hotel "fixer," who can turn any establishment around in weeks ... and he does just that in Hotel Impossible.
title: Hotel Impossible

overview: Funny and heartwarming moments ensue when a career woman finds a beaten up young man outside her apartment and she takes him in as her pet.
title: Kimi wa Pet
Финист. Первый богатырь. Фильм о фильме

overview: When a video of Fleur's lowest moment goes viral, she loses everything she has, forcing her to move back in with her parents and start her life over.
title: Tuiskoms

overview: The creators of Cheburashka brought one of the most recognizable characters of Soviet animation to the big screen. In just two weeks of release, the family film broke the absolute box office record in Russia. But how was the new version of the story about the unknown little animal born? Why did actress Olga Kuzmina, who "gave" Cheburashka her voice, have to talk to an imaginary Gena? And who came up with the final image of the "eared one"?
title: Чебурашка. История новогоднего чуда

overview: Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?
title: Medusa

overview: Who are they, young scientists living in our country and continuing their scientific work for the benefit of Russia? What are they focused on today? What discoveries can we expect from them tomorrow? The documentary series is an attempt to reveal the personality of a young scientist from Russia, comprehensively, dedicating to him, his colleagues and relatives in one episode 3 key days from the life of each hero.
title: Три дня одного года

overview: Untold Earth is a documentary series dedicated to unpacking the stories behind North America's strangest, most unique natural wonders.
title: Untold Earth

overview: This series of short videos covers a wide range of space science stories, with stunning Ultra HD/4K images of Earth and its climate to planets and the universe at large. New videos added regularly.
title: 4k Space Odyssey

overview: Nine individuals compete during a trip across South Africa. From the plains of the Kruger National Park to the spectacular coastline of The Garden Route.
title: No Time To Lose

overview: For the Win: NWSL is an immersive 4-part docuseries offering unprecedented access into the 2024 National Women's Soccer League (NWSL) playoffs and Championship. The series will take fans behind the scenes of one of the most thrilling seasons in NWSL history, chronicling the intensity, resilience, and passion that define the league's top teams and star players as they battle for the ultimate prize: the Championship trophy.
title: For The Win: NWSL

overview: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.
title: Sterling Point

overview: A real-life paranormal case based in the early 1900s in Antigonish County, Nova Scotia, about a farmhouse cursed with sudden fires.
title: The Fire Ghost of Caledonia Mills

overview: Kiwi chef Al Brown sets out to make his mark on the world of New Zealand wine, going on a journey to start his own brand and meeting up with other local entrepreneurs along the way to see what makes them tick.
title: Al Brown's Tipping Point Adventure

overview: Leanne's life takes an unexpected turn when her husband of 33 years leaves her for another woman. Starting over when you're a grandmother and in menopause isn't exactly what she had in mind, but with the help of her family she will navigate this new chapter with grace, dignity and jello salad.
title: Leanne

overview: Paula, a newly divorced mom, falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer. Convinced she witnessed a crime — while simultaneously struggling through a custody battle and an identity crisis — Paula begins her own investigation, one that could unravel a greater conspiracy while also holding the keys to rebuilding her family and sense of self.
title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed

overview: "Студия 17" (Studio 17) is a Russian comedy TV series. The premiere of the show took place 30 of September 2013 goda on TV channel TNT. It is noteworthy that the series has a lot of well-known actors, some of whom play a role cameo, that is, appear as themselves. The creators of Eugene Nikishov and Valery Fedorosovich told that they decided to come up with a story, based on their experience. Once, as the main characters of the series, Sergei, Alexander and their friends, too, in his youth created their own studio and filmed different orders: weddings, corporate parties and so on. Many of the situations that fall main characters are based on real stories experienced once the director. When the authors of the series came up with the main characters, sought to create all kinds of temperaments, with two of the characters are prototypes of real people - old friends directors. According to themselves the actors playing the role of the protagonists Many of the heroine, playing the role of mistresses, very similar to the girls who the actors knew personally. In an interview with the Radio Echo Moskvy producer of the series, Valery F., described the series as pure sitcom. Evgeny Ostrovsky, the actor playing in the series, he said that famous actors playing bit parts, and shared with the rest of his extensive experience. Even before the premiere television channel TNT has laid out a series of commercials "fictional Studio 17", which on the one hand gained viral popularity , but also introduced the Internet -users in the mass delusion. On March 22 2015 goda CEO channel TNT Igor Mishin, the radio station "Echo of Moscow" has officially announced that the second season of the series will not be.
title: Студия 17

overview: Minase Alice returned to her hometown from Tokyo for the first time in 10 years and reunited with her childhood friend, a high school boy named Harumi. The two childhood friends who have a difference in age are connected by the hearth of the old folk house where Alice lives.
title: Beside the Hearth at Alice-san's Home

overview: Former commando Ray guides sixteen adventurers through the wilderness. As they journey through the rugged Norwegian wilderness, the choice is one simple one: stay behind or keep going.
title: No way back

overview: Food geographer Pierre Raffard takes us on a culinary odyssey to discover the most exciting recipes from around the globe. Cooking Across the World sheds light on the influence of trade, colonisation and migration on food culture taking in recipes from street stalls to gourmet chef creations.
title: Voyage en cuisine

overview: Stories and legends.
title: Mae Gen i Stori

overview: Constitutional issues come to life in this Emmy Award-winning series. Key political, legal, and media professionals engage in spontaneous and heated debates on controversial issues such as campaign spending, the right to die, school prayer, and immigration reform. This series will deepen understanding of the life and power of this enduring document and its impact on history and current affairs, while bringing biases and misconceptions to light.
title: The Constitution: That Delicate Balance

overview: A fictional chronicle of the rise and fall of Emperor Yung Jing of the Qing Dynasty, through sibling rivalry and rebellions by Ming loyalists.
title: Dynasty

overview: Featuring cutting-edge science and unique access to the latest archaeological discoveries, Ramsès le Grand exposes the man behind the myth. And reveals how—for the past few thousand years—this mighty ruler has remained a caricature of his own propaganda. The pharoah's remarkable destiny unfolds in six spellbinding episodes that bring his astounding 67-year-rule to life—a legendary reign during which he turned a fallen empire into one of the most powerful realms of all time. It's an immersive journey that reveals Rameses' darkest secrets and lies along the way.
title: Ramsès le Grand

overview: Children's puppet serial by Cardiff Caricature Theatre.
title: Pippi Hosanhir

overview: Based on a rigorous journalistic investigation into three femicides that took place between March and April 2022 in the state of Nuevo León, in northern Mexico, the documentary series #Todas Debanhi: Una historia de redes offers an insider's view into two different types of networks: on the one hand, a network of complicity that allows violence against women to persist and, on the other hand, a network of resistance formed by family members and feminist activists to demand justice.
title: #Todas Debanhi: Una historia de redes

overview: Jia Jixiang and Sha Li, once strangers in a bustling city, cross paths by chance. Their journey from animosity to a whirlwind romance and flash marriage is tested by family ties, friendships, and life's struggles. After misunderstandings lead to divorce, they grow individually, only to reunite and rediscover their love.
title: Meet Love Again

overview: Vera, Nadezhda and Lyubov are three friends. They have different characters and views on the world, but they always remain true to their friendship and overcome any challenges together.
title: Подруги

overview: Children's puppet serial
title: Y Cowboi Bach

overview: Mariam's dream to inspire as a motivational influencer turns into a satirical tale of ambition, fame, and self-destruction.
title: The Fashionista

overview: These days, the term "homeless" has taken on new meaning. There are youths referred to as "net cafe refugees," who have neither a job nor a place to live, but who find themselves hopping around internet cafes. One such refugee is a 20-year-old girl named Chisato, who lost her mother at a young age due to sickness. She spent her youth trying to escape from the huge debt her father left her, and her battle with the repossessors unfolded every night. However, her life changed after meeting one man named Shinzo, changing her views on the meaning of "family." Shinzo comes from a rich family tracing back to the Edo period, and he adopted six good-looking sons with the hope of one becoming his successor, but all of them have strange personalities. Shinzo promises to free Chisato from her debt if she marries him and becomes the mother of his sons. However, a life with these six guys under one ro...
title: Atashinchi no Danshi

overview: Huub Stapel travels along the banks of the Scheldt, which starts in France and ends in the North Sea. He meets residents and explores the remarkable changes the river undergoes along the way.
title: Langs de Schelde

overview: 275 years after a ground-breaking charity concert saw George Frideric Handel perform his Messiah for the benefit of London's foundlings, Gareth Malone is set to stage his own performance of the nation's favourite choral piece in the magnificent surroundings of Cardiff's Llandaff Cathedral as a fundraiser for BBC Children in Need. The programmes will see Gareth trim hundreds of applicants down to just eight singers who have never sung in a classical choir before, and then train them to perform a work that has dominated the British choral tradition for hundreds of years. Gareth's eight singers will reveal even the most inexperienced musicians can tackle Messiah as they bring enthusiasm and hard work to this once-in-a-lifetime challenge. Gareth's new recruits, might not have tried choral music before or even heard of Handel, but they will have just seven weeks from audition to performing Messiah alongside the acclaimed BBC National Orchestra and Chorus of Wales. Also appearing will be a stellar professional cast of soprano Jessica Robinson, alto Rebecca Afonwy-Jones, baritone Roderick Williams OBE who sang at the King's Coronation, and tenor James Way.
title: Gareth Malone's Messiah

overview: The series L'arte della gioia tells the story of Modesta, a young Sicilian girl from the early 1900s who, born into poverty, fights to conquer love, freedom and power. After a tragic accident that tears her away from her family, she is welcomed into a convent where, thanks to her intelligence and stubbornness, she becomes the protégé of the Mother Superior. She later arrives at the villa of Princess Brandiforti, where she makes herself indispensable. This incessant movement of emancipation is accompanied by a path of personal and sexual maturation, which leads her to discover and claim the right to pleasure and happiness.
title: L'arte della gioia

overview: It's hard to believe that Earth is the only planet in the universe that's capable of sustaining life. Thanks to new technology, scientists have discovered planets and moons in our solar system, and beyond that may have had the qualities of a life-giving planet. Humans are destined to colonize the stars, but how far will we need to go to find a planet that can support us?
title: Life In Outer Space

overview: Professional riders Ryan Peatry and Alexey Vermuelen both agree that cycling sports need to be more accessible and inclusive. Peatry, a mountain biker, and Vermuelen, a road cyclist, recognize the barriers beginner cyclists face when it comes to buying gear, training, and finding the motivation to race competitively. They've made it their mission to help new cyclists surmount those obstacles, and in Outside TV's new series From the Ground Up they work to show that anyone with enough determination can race with the pros.
title: From the Ground Up

overview: Three assistants attempt to navigate the worlds of their famous Hollywood bosses.
title: Turning Teddy

overview: Harry Hill hosts, as judges Liam Charles and Ravneet Gill take on the tough task of finding Britain's best junior baker.
title: Junior Bake Off

overview: Their lifestyle is considered ancient, but pastoralist people contribute in many ways to preserving ecosystems and food security worldwide. Their way of life is one of the oldest, yet from an ecological aspect, it points toward the future. Mark Michel and his team visit five pastoral communities around the world. Today, scientists all over the planet are discovering the enormous value of pastoral life. Together with the shepherds, they are looking for new ways to preserve this lifestyle and to use the pastorals' knowledge for a better agricultural future that benefits everyone.
title: Herders - Guardians of The Earth

overview: Record breaking cyclone activity. Explosive volcanic eruptions. Powerful earthquakes and endless heat waves. How do scientists forecast these cataclysms? Is it possible for people in affected areas to anticipate and prepare for these natural events? Using professionally shot 4K footage to capture the heart of the action, this series explores several major natural disasters of the last few years, from the most deadly to the most dramatic.
title: The Disaster Diaries

overview: A reality-based drama series about controversial financier Jan Stenbeck who reluctantly takes over the family business Kinnevik and transforms it into a groundbreaking media empire. He makes many enemies, even within the family, and the price he pays is high.
title: Stenbeck

overview: Two groups of teenagers swap schools and exchange lives between multicultural south London and the town of Mena, Arkansas, in America's bible belt.
title: The Great School Swap: UK to USA

overview: Overview combines aerial cinematography with science storytelling to reveal both the natural phenomena and human forces shaping our planet. The series will feature stories about agriculture, engineering, the environment and natural wonders told by the scientists, rangers, farmers and artists who are responsible for innovating the world around us.
title: Overview

overview: From wildfires to hurricanes to tornadoes, Weathered will teach you about natural disasters from the people who have survived them, as well as what you can do to prepare.
title: Weathered

overview: The American Revolution was at once a war for independence, a war of conquest, a civil war, and a world war, fought by neighbors on American farms and between global powers an ocean or more away. It impacted millions from Vermont's Green Mountains to the swamps of South Carolina, from Indian Country to the Iberian Peninsula. In defeating the British Empire and giving birth to a new nation, the American Revolution turned the world upside-down. Thirteen colonies on the Atlantic Coast united in rebellion, won their independence, and established a republic that still endures. The American Revolution, our six-part, twelve-hour series on America's founding struggle, will present the story of the men and women of the Revolutionary generation, their humanity in victory and defeat, and the crisis that they lived through. By weaving together accounts of American political leaders and their British counterparts with the perspectives of the so-called ordinary people who waged and witnessed war, The American Revolution will be an expansive, evenhanded look at the virtues and the contradictions in the fight for independence and the birth of the United States.
title: The American Revolution

overview: In Katrina: Come Hell and High Water, the people of New Orleans share their stories in their own words — from what it was like to survive the hurricane to how the city and their lives have been forever changed as a result. Brimming with emotion, the series serves as a testament to the resilience of New Orleanians and a stark call for vigilance and preparation as cataclysmic natural disasters continue to become more and more commonplace all over the world.
title: Katrina: Come Hell and High Water

overview: When teenager Blake Robbins files a lawsuit claiming his school is spying on him, it sparks a wild scandal with alarming digital privacy implications.
title: Spy High

overview: Sir David Suchet travels to locations Agatha Christie visited, immersing himself in countries she explored to uncover the literary enigma's inspirations.
title: Travels With Agatha Christie & Sir David Suchet
